    # Determine intersection row: start - 0.5
    r_int = r_start - 0.5
    
    # Determine line slope from first two points
    if len(feature_points) >= 2:
        r0, c0 = feature_points[0]
        r1, c1 = feature_points[1]
        dr = r1 - r0
        dc = c1 - c0
    else:
        dr, dc = 1, 1
        
    # Calculate target line constant for perpendicular crossing
    if dr == dc:  # Feature slope +1 (c - r = k)
        k = c0 - r0
        # Target line (Slope -1): r + c = K_prime
        # K_prime = r_int + (r_int + k) = 2*r_int + k
        K_prime = 2 * r_int + k
        start_row = int(r_int) + 1
        
        for r in range(start_row, H):
            c = round(K_prime - r)
            if 0 <= c < W:
                out[r][c] = 3
                
    elif dr == -dc: # Feature slope -1 (c + r = k)
        k = c0 + r0
        # Target line (Slope +1): r - c = K_prime
        # K_prime = r_int - (k - r_int) = 2*r_int - k
        K_prime = 2 * r_int - k
        start_row = int(r_int) + 1
        
        for r in range(start_row, H):
            c = round(r - K_prime)
            if 0 <= c < W:
                out[r][c] = 3
                
    return out

    direction = 1 if c1 > c0 else -1
    
    # Equation: if slope +1: c - r = k; if slope -1: c + r = k

        start_r = r0 - 1
        c_intersect = start_r + k  # feature extrapolation at start_r
        K = start_r + c_intersect
        # Draw 3s on r + c = K starting from start_r
        for r in range(start_r, H):
            c = K - r
            if 0 <= c < W:

        # Perpendicular slope +1: c - r = K
        start_r = r0 - 1
        c_intersect = k - start_r

        for r in range(start_r, H):
